description: 2 tactical challenges for White against the Elephant Gambit. Take on e5 and punish the early ...d5.

drills.briefExplanation: 2.Nf3 d5 3.Nxe5! — take the pawn; Black's center collapses before it forms.
drills.description: White to play. Black may try the Elephant 2...d5 — develop and know the refutation.
drills.explanation: The refutation of the Elephant Gambit is brutally simple: 3.Nxe5! just takes the pawn. Black's 2...d5 sacrificed a pawn for activity that never materializes — after the knight takes on e5, White is a clean pawn up with the better center. The gambit only works if White cooperates; taking the material kills it.
drills.name: Taking the Pawn

drills.briefExplanation: 4.d3! exd3 5.Bxd3 — undermine the wedge and develop with tempo.
drills.description: White to play. Black pushed 3...e4 — undermine the advanced pawn at once.
drills.explanation: If White already took on d5, the clean antidote to 3...e4 is 4.d3! — undermining the wedge immediately. After 4...exd3 5.Bxd3 White develops with tempo, the e4 outpost never happens, and Black's gambit pawn is gone for nothing. Challenge advanced pawns at their base.
drills.name: Undermining the Wedge

name: Elephant Gambit — White Tactics
